technical.summary: Oversold bounce signals (RSI, Stoch) show early recovery momentum, but price remains below key moving averages with negative volume confirmation and no active strategy triggers—insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: AES shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 36 days creating near-term event risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (16/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent recent congressional activity and news data limit conviction; market sentiment heavily bearish (61% bears) suggests capitulation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (329.9) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinationals, and earnings in 36 days adds event risk to utilities sector already facing credit stress.
